entries.surface: Q1 Eq.(4) vs prose vs printed visibility code
entries.finding: prose defines low transition probability as high temporal anomaly; Eq.(4) uses +p, whereas printed code uses -log(prob), which is directionally consistent with the prose

entries.surface: Q1 Eq.(13), reported Pareto range and multi_objective_path_planner.py
entries.finding: constraint says 2<=n<=100, but report says Pareto path node counts 30-222; printed code limits step-choice length, then shortest-path bridge can extend decoded path, and evaluate() does not reject decoded paths >100
reported Hypervolume=0.4884; later text says HV volume coverage >=90% without visible normalization/reference-point mapping from 0.4884 to >=90%
GD is said to approach zero relative to a theoretical optimal Pareto front, but the visible method does not establish how that reference front is obtained

turning-density correlations r=0.78/0.82/0.85 with p<0.001 are author-reported; they show association but do not independently validate perceptual “移步异景” correctness because the score and route geometry share constructed structure
the same 10 gardens define min/max; Jichang Garden indicators are additionally calibrated to 100; later agreement with Jichang Garden ranking first is used as validation
AI vs connectivity and AI vs IIC are both reported at 0.99. Even if semantic roles differ, numerical independence/nonredundancy is not established and double-counting sensitivity is required
all 45 garden pairs = C(10,2)=45; arithmetic is consistent
all 55 garden pairs = C(11,2)=55; arithmetic is consistent
80 strong + 74 medium + 25 differential = 179 dimensions; arithmetic is consistent

10-garden mean comprehensive similarity is reported 0.986 and all 45 pairs >0.85; 11-garden mean 0.985 and all 55 pairs high. This is not an external accuracy/generalization criterion and may indicate representation/normalization concentration
KMeans clusters are created from the same high-dimensional vectors and one-way ANOVA on those same features is then used to establish cluster significance
some features are reported CV=0 / 100.000±0.000, while PI uses |v-mu|/sigma; zero sigma requires an explicit guard or those dimensions are undefined

Coupling Garden personality is reported 1.188 in the 10-garden analysis and 1.157 after Near Garden is added. Because PI is standardized to cohort mean/std, this can change with cohort and must be tagged by cohort rather than treated as one immutable result
several garden-similarity analyzer methods are printed as signatures/docstrings without visible bodies; PCA/KMeans helper failures fall back to zero/default features under broad except blocks
